static_traits.name: 周晟
static_traits.social_status: 有配偶与亲密朋友的支持网络，但因害怕被评判而较少分享内疚与自责感受，Interpersonal relationships因自责而紧张
static_traits.medical_history: use轮椅行动；without其他重大躯体疾病；既往without相似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, with good logic and high cooperativeness, can describe automatic thoughts and bodily reactions; tends toward overthinking and self-blame, and self-reproaching sentence patterns of 'I should ...' appear in the speech

basic_info.main_problem: 我经常觉得do not人在怪我，即使have not证据，这导致我产生内疚和自责。问题在过去几个月更为强烈，几乎每天都出现，尤其在与人互动后事情出错时更明显。
basic_info.core_demands: This guilt and self-blame are affecting my relationships and emotional health; I want to work through and overcome these patterns; I really want to find a way to stop this constant feeling of guilt.
growth_experiences: During the growth process, family members often criticized the client; when things went wrong, even if only indirectly, it was often attributed to the client. Long being in an atmosphere of criticism and blame made them gradually internalize a tendency to blame themselves first when encountering problems and take on too much responsibility.

special_situations.event: 工作中项目时间线出现问题，尚not yet讨论责任归属时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要发生差错，do not人就会把责任归到我身上；我必须立刻道歉并补救才能避免更糟的评价
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 抢先道歉、迅速加班修复、主动揽责

special_situations.event: 家庭出游因安排或天气not顺利而发生问题（该行程由自己提议）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我提出的计划not完美或出意外，就是我的错；一个好伴侣/家人应该预见并避免所有问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly apologizes and self-blames, over-explains, and avoids making suggestions afterward
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone must think I messed it up; I should have known better how to avoid this situation.

special_situations.event: 团队have not达成目标（如“我们have not赢”）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Team failure means I fail and must bear the main responsibility, otherwise others will blame me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributes failure to oneself, doubles efforts to compensate and prevent being blamed

special_situations.event: 社交场合中一旦出现任何小差错，周围的人保持沉默或not yet明确表态
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 沉默就是not满或责备；只有先道歉才能维持关系的安全
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 立即道歉、紧张Withdrawal、减少表达以避免再次被评判
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们对我失望，心里一定在责怪我。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被理解与接纳，not再被指责；希望关系中获得安全与肯定
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被责备、被评判与Being rejected，担心因失败而被negate
defense_goal: Soothes others and avoids conflict and being attacked through preemptive self-blame and apology
撤退与回避以降低被评判的风险
把责任内归因以保持对局面的控制感

object_relations.self_representation: 有过错、需要为问题承担责任的人
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh others who are always ready to place responsibility on me (family/colleagues)

object_relations.self_representation: 令伴侣失望和增添负担的人
object_relations.object_representation: 对自己not满、易被自己拖累的伴侣

manifestations: 害怕被评判而not敢向配偶与亲密朋友分享真实困扰
Feeling isolated and blamed when others are silent or things go wrong

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 担心被评判而减少向重要他人求助
反复自责与“我应该……”的自我要求
在互动出错时立刻收缩边界、谨小慎微

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 在have not证据时假设他人责怪自己（读心式归因）
将内在的自责体验Projection为他人的not满或negate

positive_force: 有配偶与亲密朋友的支持网络
愿意求助并配合治疗，动机明确
具备一定的自我观察能力（能记录并Identify automatic thoughts与身体反应）
能接受并尝试新的认知重构与行为实验
negative_force: A long-internalized pattern of self-blame and taking responsibility (stemming from family experiences of criticism and blame)
Cognitive distortions such as mind reading, over-attribution, catastrophizing, and 'should' statements
害怕被评判，导致回避分享与寻求支持
过度道歉与撤退ReinforcementAnxiety与内疚，维持问题循环
持续性内疚影响工作表现与自我照料

target_behavior.behavior: 在他人面前出现问题时立即自责并过度道歉/撤退，伴随Significant anxiety反应（心跳加快、胃部紧绷）
antecedent: 工作中项目时间线出错
家庭活动not顺利（由自己提出建议）
社交互动中出现小差错或他人沉默not yet表态
target_behavior.core_reason: 早期在家庭中频繁被批评与间接归责，形成“It is all my fault”“我会被责备”的核心信念，并在现实中以读心术、个人化和‘应该’句式等认知偏差维持
target_behavior.function: 逃避被批评与冲突、寻求他人认可与关系安全感，获得短期的Anxiety缓解与控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension、Work performance affected、日常自我照料下降，内疚与Anxiety在长期被维持
